decided: Merging a stage's pull request and switching back to the main branch become permissions the user can grant, each on its own; publishing a release and filing an issue stay the user's own acts.
alternatives: make every outward act a permission now
leave all outward acts with the user until a later stage
why: A run that moves from one stage to the next needs only those two acts; nothing on that path publishes a release or files an issue.
